additional_info.subject: ID0469601-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002722] RCD_FB1_or_MCB_FC5_AC_Charging CRM:00315003109
additional_info.body:
Hi Vale,
During a charging session the error triggered:
If FB1 tripped, it means current was finding an unintended path to earth.
If FC5 tripped, it means too much current was flowing - doesn't seem like it.
​​​​Visual Inspection:
Charging Cable: Carefully inspect the entire length of the charging cable for any signs of damage: cuts, kinks, crushing, discoloration, or exposed wires. Check the connectors at both ends.
EV Charging Port: Look inside the EVs charging port for any debris, moisture, or damage to the pins.
Charger: Check for any visible damage, signs of overheating, or moisture.
Isolate and Test (If Possible & Safe):
If you have access to another charging cable, try using that (ensuring it's safe to do so).
Try charging your EV at another SiD.
I will send this ticket back to RC-IT queue. From the logs I cannot see which component tripped. All I can offer is for you to take spare FB1 and FC5 if you wish to replace anything but I require analysis to prove it.
Thank you!
BR,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0469601-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002722] RCD_FB1_or_MCB_FC5_AC_Charging CRM:03208000120
additional_info.body:
Hi Valerio, good morning and Happy New Year :D I hope you are doing well and enjoyed your vacays with your family and friends.
Back to business.
Unfortunately, there is no reason in the logs about it but there is only one of 3 possibilities:
Over voltage
Over current
Faulty component
The FC5 has a acting time of miliseconds and it's possible that there was this peak that we cannot see in the logs since we don't have that time range of logs collection.
If this problem is starting to occur often, then I would recommend trying to replace the FC5.
If by replacing the FC5, the problem still occurs then we need to find a customer with this problem and try to reproduce it because AC charging has no logs whatsoever in EcoG.
I hope this answered your question and I will close the ticket after your feedback.
BEst regards,
Francisco
